entities.summary: Devontae Calvin Cacok is an American professional basketball player for UCAM Murcia CB of the Spanish Liga ACB and the Basketball Champions League. He played college basketball for the UNC Wilmington Seahawks, where in the 2017–18 season he led the nation in rebounding.
